name: VW / Audi
description: VW / Audi (also Škoda, SEAT) over a generic OBD-II dongle. UDS on 11-bit/500k CAN for the UDS era only -- VW/Škoda/SEAT from ~2012 (MQB, Golf 7 on), Audi from ~2008 (B8 on). Powertrain answers on the standard request+8 block; body/chassis/comfort modules answer on VAG's own request+0x6A block (gateway 710/77A, cluster 714/77E, ABS 713/77D, ...). Pre-~2012 VAG (TP2.0/K-line) can't be module-scanned over a plain dongle.

panel.title: All modules (OBD dongle)
panel.hint: Module scan for UDS-era VW/Audi over the ordinary OBD dongle — each module's own fault memory read the way VCDS lists them, deeper than generic OBD-II. Works on VW/Škoda/SEAT ≈2012+ (MQB, Golf 7 on) and Audi ≈2008+ (B8 on); earlier cars use VW's TP2.0/K-line and can't be scanned by a plain dongle. Pick the adapter top-right, ignition ON, then scan. SFD on 2020+ cars does not affect these read-only checks.
panel.scanBusy: Walking the VW/Audi modules by their VCDS addresses… (absent modules time out quietly)
